The '''Wayland Herd''' was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] herd, whose [[Ithorian Herdship]] was based the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]]. [[Iggjel]] and his [[Iggjel's friend|friend]] were members of the herd.<ref name="Iggjel" />
